snippet.title: Forgotten Eras - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Explore a Slavic folklore-inspired 2.5D Metroidvania. Guide Ivan and the Grey Wolf through a mythic kingdom, wield runes, solve puzzles, and face legends such as Domovoy and Baba Yaga reborn in a stylized, atmospheric world. Forgotten Eras is the story of a young hero, Ivan, in a thrilling and epic adventure. He is on a mission to save the Kingdom and reverse the rituals of shamans who broke the sealed book of forgotten runic magic. Unlock the power of Veles and connect with Grey Wolf. Do you have the courage it takes to reach the Baba Yaga Hut?

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3423760/Forgotten_Eras/
